# G1_TOP chip-level results (generated by summarize.py from sim/logs/*.log)

Simulation completion is separate from functional acceptance. Failed or incomplete runs have no valid final trip verdict; partial quiet-window values are retained below. Missing crossings in completed no-trip cases are not applicable.

**Historical runs without `_clockfix` are not accepted timing evidence:** the original ADC clock bridge can double-count edges in Icarus (see `../bridge_probe/README.md`). Their measurements below are retained for diagnosis, not sign-off.
